newsitem.title: USA: Prime Capital sees profitable Q4.
newsitem.headline: Prime Capital sees profitable Q4.

text.p: Prime Capital Corp said it anticipates a profitable fourth quarter due to completion of securitization of about $66.3 million of its equipment loan and lease receivables on Dec. 13, 1996.

Fee and other income associated with this transaction will be recognized in the company's financial results for the fourth quarter ending Dec. 31, 1996, it said. "Based on this securitization, we currently anticipate a profitable fourth quarter for Prime," said chief executive James Friedman.

He said, "With a backlog of approved financed transactions of approximately $145 million, more than double the backlog at this time a year ago, we are optimistic about the company's continued growth in 1997," he said.

For the nine months ended Sept. 30, Prime reported net income of $2.4 million, or $0.54 per share, on revenue of $9.6 million. Net income was $79,000, or $0.02 per share, on revenue of $6.3 million for the first nine months of 1995.
Prime provides financial services to health care and other businesses.
